caption: MCP Subscription Filter
description:
The set of notification types a client may opt in to on a
{@link SubscriptionsListenRequestsubscriptions/listen} request.

Each notification type is **opt-in**; the server **MUST NOT** send
notification types the client has not explicitly requested here. Generated from the pinned MCP schema (2026-07-28 SubscriptionFilter).
name: mcp_subscription_filter

mcp_resource_subscriptions.description:
MCP member `resourceSubscriptions`: Subscribe to {@link ResourceUpdatedNotificationnotifications/resources/updated} for these resource URIs.
Replaces the former `resources/subscribe` RPC.
